name: Dark Chocolate Pistachio Almond Cranberry Bites
ingredientsText: Dark chocolate (unsweetened chocolate, sugar, cocoa butter, sunflower lecithin, vanilla), dried cranberries (cranberries, sugar, sunflower oil), almonds, pistachios, hemp protein.
containsStatement: Allergen information: Contains almonds and pistachios.
mayContainStatement: May contain milk, soy, and other nuts. Made in a facility that also produces dairy products, cashews, peanuts, soy, and other nuts. In rare cases, may contain nut shell pieces.
notes: 'dairy products' in the facility statement is read as milk. Sunflower lecithin is not soy. Hemp is not one of the 9.
